listenings.text: It was fine. He talked about taxes, for some companies. He was not happy with his accountant. He wants a price quickly. And there is a deadline, in the middle of the year, more or less.

Very well. He said their main requirement was tax filing for three companies. He told me their accountant was too slow: the turnaround was three weeks. He said he would need our quote on Monday. And he told me the deadline was the end of June.
